title: check-* skill findings report
description: Shared machine-readable output contract emitted by every .claude/skills/check-* drift skill (check-schema-drift, check-code-drift, check-docs-drift, check-examples, check-spec). The fenced block in each skill's report MUST use the info-string `findings-json` so the eval harness (#796) can grep-extract it. Epic #1016 — one object-wrapper report per run.

command.description: Which check-* skill produced this report.

commit.description: Git commit SHA the check ran against (skill captures `git rev-parse HEAD`).

checked_files.description: Repo-relative paths actually examined this run (so reviewers can see scope, and the eval harness can detect under-scoping).

findings.description: Every drift finding. Empty array = no drift detected.

positive_notes.description: Things verified as correct/aligned. Kept out of `findings` so a clean run is an empty findings array, not a list of severity:info items.

suppressed_as_duplicate_of_known_issue.description: Count of findings suppressed because they match an already-open GitHub issue (per the cross-reference step). Recorded, not silently dropped.

telemetry.description: Injected by the runner (Claude Code), NOT self-reported by the model — an LLM cannot measure its own token use or wall-clock. Optional; present when run via the eval harness.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the drifting artifact.

line.description: 1-based line in `file`, or null when not line-addressable.

severity.description: Per the shared severity-rubric.md. When uncertain, assign `info`.

category.description: Skill-specific finding category. Each skill documents its own enum in SKILL.md; common values: field_presence, field_type, required_optional, yaml_tag, ref_type, validation, vocabulary, cross_reference, normative_language, example_validation, pedagogical.

message.description: What drifted and why it matters.

validator_caught.description: true if a deterministic tool (glx validate / validate-schemas.mjs / a CI check / go test) already flags this. Lets reviewers see what the LLM added beyond the deterministic layer.

llm_only.description: true if only the LLM semantic pass surfaced this (no deterministic check covers it). MUST be the logical inverse of validator_caught.

location.description: Optional precise source coordinates. When the skill can supply line numbers (e.g. fed by the #795 AST extractor), findings without them are dropped rather than emitted as low-confidence noise.
